moments.evidence: Un anell lleuger penja d’una tira gruixuda de paper presa entre les mans.
Esquinça la tira per una osca. La part inferior i l’anell comencen a baixar junts.
L’anell i el tros inferior jeuen damunt la taula. La mà encara subjecta la part superior.

continuity.anchor: Un anell gran de plàstic i dos fragments complementaris de la mateixa tira verda.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural young adult woman with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un anell lleuger penja d’una tira gruixuda de paper presa entre les mans. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Esquinça la tira per una osca. La part inferior i l’anell comencen a baixar junts. RIGHT result: L’anell i el tros inferior jeuen damunt la taula. La mà encara subjecta la part superior. Continuity and accounting: Un anell gran de plàstic i dos fragments complementaris de la mateixa tira verda. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image.
attempts.review: El paper es trenca més avall de l’osca i la mà dreta continua sostenint el fragment inferior amb l’anell. El resultat es podria explicar perquè la mà el deixa anar després.

attempts.prompt: Create ONE wide educational raster stimulus with three equal side-by-side panels, large white gutters and margins, white studio background, exactly the same single actor and all the same props with identical scale, perspective, viewing angle and lighting throughout. Synthetic photorealistic studio photography with one natural young adult woman with realistic skin, clothing, anatomy, grip and reach. The actor has olive skin and straight dark hair. Draw or photograph the following Catalan causal brief without writing any words. LEFT baseline: Un anell lleuger penja d’una tira gruixuda de paper presa entre les mans. CENTER show the exact physical contact mechanism and onset of the change, with the relevant parts fully visible: Esquinça la tira per una osca. La part inferior i l’anell comencen a baixar junts. RIGHT result: L’anell i el tros inferior jeuen damunt la taula. La mà encara subjecta la part superior. Continuity and accounting: Un anell gran de plàstic i dos fragments complementaris de la mateixa tira verda. Fully visible hands, joints, support, edges and all the objects, enough free space around the figures, exact object dimensions and quantities. Keep the same props and furniture in all three panels. No graphics, arrows, motion lines, words, letters, digits, logos or watermark. Wide horizontal image. Specific production fix: Correct this visual failure from a previous candidate: El paper es trenca més avall de l’osca i la mà dreta continua sostenint el fragment inferior amb l’anell. El resultat es podria explicar perquè la mà el deixa anar després. Uncut green strap tied in a closed loop around a yellow ring at its bottom end. The agent grips the strap from two sides near a visibly large pre-cut V-notch higher up in the strap. In CENTER the horizontal tear opens FROM the V-notch; neither hand holds the lower segment. The lower separated piece is clearly seen in early free fall with the attached ring above the table. In RIGHT ring and lower piece rest on table, upper stays in hand. Both fragments reconstruct one strap.
attempts.review: La ruptura comença a l’osca i la part baixa amb l’anell queda en l’aire quan perd el suport. Les mans retenen només la part superior i al final hi ha dos fragments.
